d.ko: Join Vinnie in a battle against powerful criminal organizations in Chicago. With his sidekicks Shorty and Kiro, navigate a dangerous world of violence and greed. Use special tactics, powerful weapons, and specialized skills to survive. Uncover secrets and be merciless.
